page.title: WeCom Mail
page.description: Delivers sign-up verification codes, password security notices and site notifications through the WeCom “app send email” API — no SMTP server or sending domain required.
page.noSecrets: The platform encryption key is not configured, so WeCom credentials cannot be saved.
field.corpIdHint: WeCom admin console → My Enterprise → Enterprise info.
field.corpSecretHint: Leave empty to keep the saved secret. Only re-enter it when switching enterprise or after regenerating it.
field.fromHint: WeCom decides the actual From address from the app's bound mailbox; this is for operator reference only.
field.baseUrlHint: Defaults to https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com; point it at an internal proxy or mirror if needed.
field.publicBaseUrlHint: Used to turn in-site notification links into absolute URLs, e.g. https://panel.example.com.
field.excludeTypesHint: Comma-separated type prefixes. For example security. keeps all security notices in-app only.
test.title: Send a test email
test.hint: The test really calls WeCom, so it verifies the credentials, the mailbox permission and the trusted-IP allowlist at once.
help.title: Three prerequisites before enabling this
help.steps: ① Create a self-built app in the WeCom console and copy its corpid and secret; ② the app must have the enterprise-mailbox (mail) permission; ③ if the enterprise enables trusted IPs, add this server's egress IP, otherwise the API answers 60020.
